propositions: Each fallback candidate must emit exactly one OTel span with zero-based order, model identity, outcome (returned/raised), and optional provider usage without changing RunUsage accounting or S2 control flow.
Candidate spans nest as children of a single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context; the outer InstrumentedModel from instrument_all is parent, no duplication.
Error text on raised candidate spans is sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic keyed under message and stripped of prompt, response, credential, and endpoint body before emission.

The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade becomes legible as native attempt raised then prompted attempt returned, each routing through the same wrapped candidates with no _pai_structured change.
Span emission or exporter failure when tracing is enabled is swallowed at the wrapper boundary so fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception remain identical to tracing-off.
Tracing disabled and lean-import (base install without tracing extras) produce identical results and exceptions with no span dependency errors.
